definitions.explanation: A member of the Japanese Cabinet who serves as head of a ministry or holds a special portfolio. Appointed by the Prime Minister and collectively responsible for government policy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{国務大臣|こくむだいじん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{任命|にんめい}→任命：09764_ninmei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new minister of state was appointed.

examples.japanese: {国務大臣|こくむだいじん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{答弁|とうべん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Ministers of state have an obligation to respond in the Diet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{憲法|けんぽう}→憲法：02744_kenpou⟧⟦によると→〜によると：03104_niyoruto⟧、{国務大臣|こくむだいじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{過半数|かはんすう}→過半数：05610_kahansuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国会議員|こっかいぎいん}→国会議員：20949_kokkaigiin⟧で⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: According to the constitution, a majority of ministers of state must be members of the Diet.

notes:
The formal constitutional term for members of the Japanese Cabinet (⟦{内閣|ないかく}→内閣：04800_naikaku⟧). Under Article 68 of the Japanese Constitution, the Prime Minister appoints 国務大臣, and a majority must be chosen from among members of the Diet. The maximum number of ministers is set by law (currently 17, or 20 in special circumstances).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国務大臣|こくむだいじん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{任命|にんめい}→任命：09764_ninmei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to appoint a minister of state
- {国務大臣|こくむだいじん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{罷免|ひめん}→罷免：29397_himen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to dismiss a minister of state
- {国務大臣|こくむだいじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{辞任|じにん}→辞任：10144_jinin⟧: resignation of a minister of state
- {国務大臣|こくむだいじん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{答弁|とうべん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: a minister responds in the Diet

USAGE:
In everyday news reporting, the shorter term ⟦{大臣|だいじん}→大臣：03417_daijin⟧ or the specific portfolio title (e.g., {外務大臣|がいむだいじん}, {財務大臣|ざいむだいじん}) is used more often than the formal 国務大臣.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大臣|だいじん}→大臣：03417_daijin⟧: minister — shorter, more common form used in general speech
- ⟦{閣僚|かくりょう}→閣僚：20561_kakuryou⟧: cabinet member — collective term for all cabinet members
- ⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧: prime minister — the head of the cabinet
